scope: Design review only; no benchmark, active source or candidate mutations.

findings.issue: The candidate intentionally leaves actual helper/bubblewrap/JVM ownership topology and live-slot mapping unresolved. In particular, parent-server SIGKILL cannot run Java finally or retire/reap transitions. Current launcher has --die-with-parent, but adding a startup helper and transferred images introduces a new parent-death chain; enumerating descendants afterward is not containment against exit/reparent races. VS27 currently promises no orphan without specifying how the new helper is covered.
findings.requested_change: Before implementation approval freeze a lifecycle/topology table identifying parent/PID-start identity, death propagation/containment, fd owner and permit owner for each helper, bubblewrap and JVM state. Preserve explicit --die-with-parent/pid-namespace semantics and specify the helper parent-death mechanism. Define atomic registration before exposing/cancelling a launched child, idempotent cleanup owner, dead/reaped versus cleanup-incomplete state and exact single-release rule. Add deterministic SIGKILL at each topology stage and spawn-versus-cancel/register races; no replacement session or permit release while old ownership is uncertain.

findings.issue: The purported exact declaration is truncated at `publishable { witnessSession with phase`, because the record update contains := before the theorem proof separator. It does not freeze the full VSM22 proposition and cannot support the claimed exact22-type review/build comparison.
findings.requested_change: Freeze complete elaborated expected theorem types or parse declaration syntax structurally rather than split on first :=. Include the full witness publication proposition and validate inventory completeness in the registered verifier before two-build closure.

permit_refinement: Retain staged request ownership through final dependency scan/publication decision. Under one documented linearization discipline publish/advance sequence/mark clean idle/release active permit, or retire on cancellation; reset acknowledgement alone must not permit a second request to overwrite the staged operation. Test cancel/arrival after reset but during final fence. Global live slot remains held until whole-tree exit and closure; model releaseReaped itself is unrestricted and does not prove exactly-once ownership.

Reuse cannot remove SQL authorization, both build scans or fresh child-loader cost. Resolve U01 with actual loader/reset/retirement profile and complete unchanged100/1000HTTP evidence; retain all startup/retirement failures. Prefer separately reviewed combined context bridge if session complexity has insufficient measured benefit.
positive_assessment: Advisory-only scope correctly keeps durable recovery/commit/solver exit evidence on one-shot workers.
Exact identities, one pipe owner, incremental bounds, staged DATA plus observed RESET_READY, poison-on-error and no ambiguous retry are appropriate.
Fresh child-loader audit, byte-only boundary, JDK-global caches/thread locals and finite retirement are explicitly mandatory rather than inferred from fresh objects.
Immutable classpath with full live-build fences avoids lazy mutable-disk class loading; packaging/fd transfer remains unimplemented and blocking.
formal_limit: 22 abstract propositions establish only modeled predicates and assumed observations; no theorem proves clean reset, Alloy equivalence, process-tree containment, exact-once semaphore release or latency. fresh_correspondence_is_required assumes the desired equivalence.287 inherited exact types require separate preservation checks.
commercialization: No commercial readiness follows. Dependency/dataset redistribution and licensing rights remain unresolved; named manual accessibility/browser evidence, operational memory/process cost, fault recovery and support economics remain independent gates. Session reuse adds operational and correctness obligations that a warm speed result cannot discharge.
